verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management platform that describes automation and moving cases between agents and the team, so asking whether it can connect to MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions MCP, MCP-client support, or plugging in external tool servers. Its documented APIs (Alerts, Case, listing, import, filing) are inbound integration surfaces, not MCP-client capability, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
